body:
Edge is dedicated to supporting all top assets.

If you do not see your favorite cryptocurrency here, please reach out to support@edge.app to inquire about adding support. We will consider all requests.

​

Currently supported assets are:

  • Algorand (ALGO)

  • Avalanche C-Chain (AVAX)

  • Bitcoin (BTC)

  • Bitcoin Cash (BCH)

  • Bitcoin Gold (BTG)

  • Binance Smart Chain (BNB) & any BEP-20 tokens

  • BNB Beacon Chain (BNB) - note: BEP-2 tokens not supported

  • Celo (CELO)

  • Dash (DASH)

  • DigiByte (DGB)

  • Dogecoin (DOGE)

  • EOS Network (EOS)

  • Ethereum Classic (ETC)

  • Ethereum (ETH) & any ERC-20 tokens*

  • EthereumPoW (ETHW)

  • Fantom (FTM)

  • Feathercoin (FTC)

  • Filecoin (FIL)

  • FIO Protocol (FIO)

  • Firo (FIRO)

  • Groestlcoin (GRS)

  • Hedera (HBAR)

  • Liberland (LLD)

  • Litecoin (LTC)

  • Monero (XMR)

  • Optimism (ETH)

  • Pirate Chain (ARRR)

  • Polkadot (DOT)

  • Polygon (MATIC)

  • PulseChain (PLS)

  • Qtum (QTUM)

  • Ravencoin (RVN)

  • Ripple (XRP)

  • Rootstock RSK (RBTC)

  • SmartCash (SMART)

  • Solana (SOL)

  • Stellar (XLM)

  • Telos (TLOS)

  • Tezos (XTZ)

  • Tron (TRX) & any TRC-20 tokens

  • Uniform Fiscal Object (UFO)

  • Vertcoin (VTC)

  • Zcash (ZEC)

  • Zcoin (XZC)

  • zkSync (ETH)

    ​

Note:
This list may be incomplete. We are consistently working to bring new coins and features into Edge to empower end-users of crypto, all across the world!

* If you have questions about adding or viewing your tokens (i.e. USDT on Ethereum), please see this article: How do I add Custom ERC20 Tokens?
